name: Lawman Tormod

intro.text: I am here for the Law Ting. Someone has to be. Nobody has legislated on that holm for a few centuries, but I like to be ready.

win: A fair judgement. I will report the finding to the loch.
after: The Norse loved a good assembly. They would argue for days and then go home and not change anything. It is a tradition we have kept up.
